title: PopupMenu Item ID being an Int32 causes overflow issue for int hash
body:
### Tested versions

- Tested in Godot Engine v4.4.1.stable.mono

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable.mono - Manjaro Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri May  9 12:16:05 UTC 2025 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 Ti (nvidia; 570.144) - AMD Ryzen 7 3800X 8-Core Processor (16 threads)

### Issue description

While making a option drop down that dynamically adds new options based on a list of files. creating an item id using the String.hash function to generate an int, sometimes overflows the int32 used for PopupMenu.item.id which then gets reset to 0 due to it not accepting a negative number.

### Steps to reproduce

```gdscript
var ThemesAvaliable:Array
ThemesAvaliable.append("default")
	
	var dir := DirAccess.open("user://project/themes/")
	if dir == null: printerr("Could not open folder"); return
	dir.list_dir_begin()
	for file: String in dir.get_files():
		ThemesAvaliable.append(file)

for t:String in ThemesAvaliable:
	ThemeOptions.add_item(t.trim_suffix(".tres"), shash)
```
this pseudo code will produce an int64 based on a string name and set the id which is an int32 and overflows to a negative number which then is set to 0 by the PopupMenu.
